title: Smiling Graduate & Family Under Leafy Tree - Vintage 1960s B&W Snapshot Photo
description: A side-profile snapshot of a smiling young woman wearing a traditional mortarboard and academic gown, adorned with flowers, attending her graduation ceremony in early 1966. Standing beside her are family members, including a woman styled with a classic 1960s bouffant bob and a man in a dark suit. They are gathered outdoors beneath a spreading leafy tree on campus. The bottom border bears the factory stamp 'FEB 1966'.
